title: Accounting Basis for the Value Placed on a Travel Credit Voucher — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A travel credit voucher is raised for the value a cancelled Air Ticket Fare Brands ticket still carries, in the name of the traveller the ticket was issued to, and it carries an expiry set by the credit validity term of the fare brand that produced it.

## 1. The two movements that must already stand on the ledger

The value placed on a travel credit voucher is settled only after the booking's ledger carries the penalty entry owed for every traveller recorded as not having flown, and that entry is taken off the fare, tax and service lines standing on the booking.

Before that value is worked out the booking's ledger must already carry the payout entry owed for the carrier-imposed taxes on an unflown ticket, and whatever that entry has returned to the form of payment used is taken off as well.

What is left after those two movements is the residual value of the ticket. The fare, tax and service lines standing on the booking are the fare lines read together; the penalty entry is taken off them, and what the payout entry has returned to the form of payment used is taken off as well.

## 2. From the residual value to the subtotal

2.1 The agency service lines standing on the booking are then taken off the residual value in full — the whole of them, a share of 1.

2.2 No optional extra already bought is carried onto the voucher: of the optional-extra lines standing on the booking, a share of 0 is carried.

2.3 The residual value, less what is taken off for the service lines and plus what is carried for the optional extras, makes the subtotal.

## 3. The three shares and the order they act in

The promptness share acts on that subtotal, the brand's credit share acts on the result of that step, and the membership uplift acts on the result of that second step, so that the three never act together on the residual value.

3.1 The unnotified promptness share of the subtotal is carried forward: 0.94 of it, being 94 percent.
3.2 The short-credit share of that figure is placed on the voucher: 0.9 of it, being 90 percent.
3.3 No membership uplift is added: the uplift stands at 0 percent, so the figure is carried at itself.

The value placed on the voucher is rounded to the nearest cent.

## 4. Worked figure, on hypothetical inputs

A cancelled booking whose fare, tax and service lines come to 1200.00 USD, whose ledger carries a penalty entry of 300.00 USD and a payout entry that returned 61.40 USD, and whose agency service lines come to 49.90 USD.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| the fare, tax and service lines standing on the booking | 1200.00 USD |
| less the penalty entry of 300.00 USD and the 61.40 USD returned by the payout entry, giving the residual value | 838.60 USD |
| less the agency service lines of 49.90 USD, taken off in full | 788.70 USD |
| plus the optional extras carried, none of them | 788.70 USD, the subtotal |
| the promptness share of 0.94 acting on the subtotal | 741.378 |
| the credit share of 0.9 acting on that result | 667.2402 |
| the uplift of 0 percent acting on that second result | 667.2402 |
| rounded to the nearest cent | 667.24 USD |
